scope: DWC-local temporal-performance and dependency-aware invalidation qualification study
verifiedBehaviors: Policy-source drift invalidates only DW03, DW06, DW07 and DW08 in the qualification graph.
Invalidating dependency-topology drift invalidates the consumer and its invalidating descendants.
Non-invalidating observation edges do not trigger revalidation.
Owner identity drift invalidates dependents even when content digest is unchanged.
Dangling and cyclic invalidation dependencies fail closed.
Dependency flags reject string/number coercion and require real booleans.
Incomplete timing leaves TTVP/slack unknown rather than inventing precise values.
Known critical path and numeric slack require explicit stage duration basis and an exact policy deadline source.
Public Exchange dates alone cannot establish local TTVP, compromise, eradication or recovery timing.
nonClaims: Synthetic cost units are not production CPU, wall-clock or monetary savings.
Synthetic timing values are not production SLO measurements.
Historical replay does not establish present exploitability or any organization's response latency.
This evidence does not justify shared Composition promotion by itself.
This evidence does not grant scheduling, authorization, effect, security-verdict or domain-acceptance authority.
